overview: The Community Development Board recommended approval to City Council for a cafe special permit at 640 Boston Avenue and approved site plans and special permits with conditions for Raising Cane's at 760 Fellsway. The board also approved site plan review and granted dimensional special permits for an addition at 200 Boston Avenue.

items.title: 640 Boston Ave Special Permit Recommendation
items.summary: Voted to recommend City Council approval of a special permit for an eating place and cafe in a 700-square-foot ground-floor space at 640 Boston Avenue.

items.title: 760 Fellsway Raising Cane's Approvals
items.summary: Voted to recommend approval of an extended hours special permit and an off-street loading waiver to City Council, and approved site plan review and the special permit with conditions including traffic mitigation, engineering resolution, and native plantings.

items.title: 200 Boston Ave Site Plan Review and Dimensional Special Permit
items.summary: Following Chair Blumberg's recusal, the board approved site plan review and granted special permits with conditions for rear setback and open space dimensional relief for a 40,000-square-foot research addition atop an existing parking garage.

items.title: April 26 Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Voted to table consideration of the April 26 meeting minutes to the next meeting because they were not yet prepared.

items.title: Board Updates and Upcoming Term Expirations
items.summary: Staff briefed the board on upcoming June term expirations, recruitment of new members, interim representation on the Community Preservation Committee, and anticipated upcoming applications.
